findings.title: Working-hours check compares start to start, so the end bound is never enforced
findings.body: `end` is computed from `slotStartTime` (same expression as `start`) rather than from the slot end time. The check `end > workingHour.endTime` therefore only tests the slot start, and slots that run past the end of working hours are accepted. Also, `workingHours.find` returns true if any one working-hour entry fails, so a user with several entries on one day (split shifts) is rejected for every slot outside any single entry. Working hours are in the organizer's tz minutes but are compared to UTC slot minutes without any conversion. The check is likely wrong and could wrongly drop valid slots.

findings.title: Dead comparison of Dayjs objects with ===
findings.body: `dayjs(a) === dayjs(b)` compares object references and is always false. The intended zero-length override (unavailable day) case is never handled. A day marked unavailable with start equal to end is therefore not blocked here, since the following isBefore/isAfter checks do not catch it either.

findings.title: Override offset logic is fragile and breaks across day boundaries
findings.body: The offset is derived from tz offsets at `override.start`, then hour/minute are taken after shifting. If the shift crosses midnight, the start or end wraps to a different day and the minutes-of-day value ends up with endTime < startTime (the slot loop skips start >= end). The override then yields no slots. Also `dayjs(override.start.toString())` reparses a locale-dependent Date string; use the Date directly. The `activeOverrides` filter still selects by the unshifted UTC start, so the day matching is inconsistent with the shifted times.

findings.title: Override day comparison done in UTC after shifting by a sign-flipped offset
findings.body: The override date is shifted by `-offset` of the organizer timezone and then compared by UTC calendar date to the slot's UTC date. For invitees in other timezones, or for overrides near midnight, the match can fall on the wrong day. `dateOverrideExist` is also set before the range checks, so a slot on a matching date but outside the override range is rejected. Inconsistent with the invitee-tz handling in getSlots.
